batch: Stage11 original10 Robot Kingdom development regression

answers.goal_related_exploration: Not demonstrated: E2/E4 discover 35/43 key recipe relations versus 40/43 in E0/E1; some earlier local chains coexist with omitted prerequisite discovery.
answers.timely_execution: Visited-state execution rates and some successful trajectories improve, but all methods remain 4/10 at40 with no recovered failure.

limitations: 10 developed families, one physical seed each, no unseen-generalization evidence.
Remote model samples are not strictly paired.
E2/E3/E4 share explicit final-goal base-action priority.
Timely execution denominators depend on knowledge and visited states.
Conditional conversion lag excludes unconverted recipes.
Local native-progress proposals can include surplus production and quantity-only rewrites.
One-step toggle branches retain prior state and do not establish full-trajectory causality.
Equal observed binary outcomes and zero-width bootstrap do not prove equivalence.
Costs use frozen conservative peak-price accounting with observed cache tokens, not provider invoices.
